subject: Glacier Data: invoice split, VAT cert, and early-pay pilot request
messages:
From: Oliver Barnes <oliver@glacierdata.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@glacierdata.com
Date: 2026-01-12T09:22:00-05:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding: billing cadence & early-pay option for Glacier Data

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick onboarding checklist last week. A few billing items we need to lock down on our side so AP can accept Redwood POs cleanly:

- We invoice monthly but need two line items reflected on each invoice (platform fees + usage overage). Can Redwood issue a single PO that maps two invoice lines (or two child POs) so our AR system can auto-apply?
- Standard payment term we expect is Net 60 (EU customer base), but we are open to a commercial early-pay arrangement if Redwood offers it (we can offer a 1% discount for Net 30 or consider an early-pay program).
- VAT: please confirm whether Redwood requires a VAT certificate on file — attaching ours for your records.

I've attached a sample invoice and our VAT cert. If possible we'd like the PO to include remit instructions for electronic invoicing (ap@glacierdata.com) and indicate whether Redwood supports split/invoice-line mapping in the vendor portal.

Goal: have PO/portal mapping and terms confirmed so we can issue our first invoice at month-end without manual rework.

Thanks,
Oliver Barnes
Head of Finance
Glacier Data Solutions
Attachments: Glacier_VAT_Certificate.pdf, Glacier_sample_invoice.xlsx

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Barnes <oliver@glacierdata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-12T11:08:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: billing cadence & early-pay option for Glacier Data

Hi Oliver — thanks, got the VAT cert and sample invoice. Looping in Marissa (vendor onboarding) and Neha (AP) so we can align PO mapping and payment options.

Two quick clarifications so we can update the onboarding form and PO template:
1) Do you need one PO with two invoice line items (we support that) or two distinct PO numbers per line? Either is doable, just want to confirm for our PO field mapping.
2) For early-pay: are you asking Redwood to pay earlier than Net 60 in exchange for your discount, or do you plan to accept Redwood's early-pay financing (third-party) if we enable it? Which commercial model do you prefer?
3) Remit and e-invoice: we'll set remit to ap@glacierdata.com in the vendor record; do you use PEPPOL or an EDI endpoint, or will you accept PDF invoices to that inbox?

I attached our standard vendor onboarding form link (I filled the basics from your attachment). Marissa — can you confirm whether we should create two child PO lines or one PO with two lines for this account? Neha — any EU VAT handling notes we should flag before we finalize the PO?

Best,
Mina Haddad
Vendor Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake_vendor_onboarding_form

From: Oliver Barnes <oliver@glacierdata.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@glacierdata.com
Date: 2026-01-13T08:47:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: billing cadence & early-pay option for Glacier Data

Thanks, Mina — answers below and a few specifics to make sure our AR system matches yours:

On Mon, Jan 12, 2026 at 11:08 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
> Do you need one PO with two invoice line items or two distinct PO numbers per line?

We prefer one PO with two distinct invoice line items (platform fees + usage overage). Our invoice parser can match lines to PO-line identifiers if Redwood provides line-level item codes.

> For early-pay: are you asking Redwood to pay earlier than Net 60 in exchange for your discount, or do you plan to accept Redwood's early-pay financing (third-party) if we enable it?

We are proposing two options — either works for us, please advise which you'd prefer operationally:
- Option A: Standard Net 60; Glacier offers a 1% discount if Redwood can commit to Net 30 payment on a per-invoice basis.
- Option B: Enroll Glacier in Redwood's early-pay program (if available) where Redwood (or partner) advances payment for a small program fee (we'd accept program terms if you can provide DocuSign link for enrollment).

On VAT/e-invoice: we will accept emailed PDF invoices to ap@glacierdata.com for now. If Redwood supports PEPPOL in EU later, we can switch.

Attachments: re-attaching Glacier_VAT_Certificate.pdf and a sanitized sample invoice showing the two-line layout.

Looking to close PO mapping by Friday so we can bill for January usage.

Regards,
Oliver Barnes
Head of Finance, Glacier Data Solutions
Attachments: Glacier_VAT_Certificate.pdf, Glacier_sample_invoice.xlsx

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-14T11:05:00-05:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendor onboarding: billing cadence & early-pay option for Glacier Data — decision needed

Marissa / Neha — forwarding Glacier's ask. Quick summary and recommended ops path:

- PO mapping: vendor prefers 1 PO with two invoice line items. Recommend we create a single PO with two line items and include item codes; Marissa, please add the PO line codes to the onboarding record and set "allow line-level matching" in our vendor portal.
- Early-pay: Glacier will accept either the buyer-accelerated Net30 (with 1% discount) or our early-pay program. If we enable the early-pay pilot for them we'll need a signed agreement (DocuSign) and finance sign-off on the program fee.
- VAT/e-invoice: vendor will accept emailed PDFs for now. Neha, flag any EU VAT blocking items (we should store their VAT cert in the vendor file).

Related links: onboarding form (https://drive.google.com/drive/fake_vendor_onboarding_form), proposed DocuSign enrollment (https://docusign.com/mock/GlacierEarlyPayAgreement). Attachments in thread: Glacier_VAT_Certificate.pdf, Glacier_sample_invoice.xlsx

Asks for you both:
1) Marissa — confirm we can push a PO with two lines and include the item codes by EOD Friday so Glacier can invoice month-end.
2) Neha — can we enroll them in a Net30-with-discount customer exception, or do you prefer to pilot the formal early-pay program? Any VAT considerations?

If you both sign off I'll follow up with Oliver and get the DocuSign started if they prefer the program.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Vendor Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
